title: 1.6 Emma Smith and Others, Statement, October 1, 1842
book: The First Fifty Years of Relief Society
notes: 119 primary documents; Church Historians Press; EN-only

footnotes.text: Joseph Smith et al., “Notice,” May 11, 1842, Joseph Smith Collection, 1827–1846, CHL; Joseph Smith et al., “Notice,”Times and Seasons,June 15, 1842, 3:830.

The men’s petition stated: “We have given the above rule of marriage as the only one practiced in this church, to show that Dr. J. C. Bennett’s ‘secret wife system’ is a matter of his own manufacture; and further to disabuse the public ear, and shew that the said Bennett and his misanthropic friend Origen Bachelor, are perpetrating a foul and infamous slander upon an innocent people, and need but be known to be hated and despised.” The rest of the petition was very similar to the women’s reproduced below. (“On Marriage,”Times and Seasons,Oct. 1, 1842, 3:939.)

Joseph F. Smith, Affidavits about Celestial Marriage, 1869–1915, CHL, Eliza R. Snow, Affidavit, Salt Lake Co., Utah Territory, June 7, 1869, 1:25; and Sarah Ann Whitney Kimball, Affidavit, Salt Lake Co., Utah Territory, June 19, 1869, 1:36.
Brian C. Hales,Joseph Smith’s Polygamy,3 vols. (Salt Lake City: Greg Kofford Books, 2013), 2:33–61.

For a similar differentiation, before the public announcement of Latter-day Saint plural marriage in 1852, between the “spiritual wife doctrine” and the “holy and sacred ordinances” of sealing (including sealings between men and plural wives), see Parley P. Pratt, “This Number Closes the First Volume of the ‘Prophet,’”Prophet,May 24, 1845, [2]; see also “A Special Conference of the Elders,”Deseret News,Extra, Sept. 14, 1852, 14–22.
Eliza R. Snow to Joseph F. Smith, n.d., Joseph F. Smith, Papers, 1854–1918, CHL, underlining in original.
“Marriage,” ca. Aug. 1835, in Doctrine and Covenants 101, 1835 ed., inJSP,R2:561.
LaJean Purcell Carruth and Mark Lyman Staker, “John Taylor’s June 27, 1854, Account of the Martyrdom,”BYU Studies50, no. 3 (2011): 43.

Bennett’s excommunication was announced in Joseph Smith et al., “Notice,”Times and Seasons,June 15, 1842, 3:830. A full disclosure about Bennett’s history, supported by documents, was published in Joseph Smith, “To the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter Day Saints, and to All the Honorable Part of Community,”Wasp,June 25, 1842, [3]; that article was reprinted in theTimes and Seasonson July 1, 1842.
